claim:
Text: "Kanye West was ahead of Biden and Trump in the Kentucky polls in October 2020"
Claim author: Kanye West
Claim date: October 13, 2020
Claim origin: https://web.archive.org/web/20210407034642/https://twitter.com/kanyewest
before_justification: The fact-check investigation uncovered no credible polling data from Kentucky in October 2020 that included Kanye West as a presidential candidate. Evidence reviewed addressed unrelated topics, such as [ballot access issues in South Carolina](https://www.postandcourier.com/politics/kanye-west-fails-to-submit-petition-signatures-needed-to-get-on-sc-presidential-ballot/article_e1dd255e-caa1-11ea-b57d-437173ca8e9c.html) and a [student poll methodology in Pennsylvania](https://www.wcupa.edu/sciences-mathematics/mathematics/documents/RamPollReport492021.pdf), but provided no information on Kentucky polls. There was also no indication that any [reputable news outlet](https://www.wsaz.com/2020/09/04/kanye-west-files-to-be-on-presidential-ballot-in-ky/) or [polling aggregator](https://ballotpedia.org/Presidential_voting_trends_in_Kentucky) reported West leading in such polls. Consequently, the claim was refuted due to a complete absence of substantiating evidence.
after_justification: A [poll conducted in early October 2020](https://oversightdemocrats.house.gov/sites/democrats.oversight.house.gov/files/CRCL%20Our%20Vote%202020%20Report%2010.1.20_FINALv2.pdf/created) by Bluegrass Data, as reported, included [Kanye West](https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/electronic-poll-books/created) as a named presidential candidate on the Kentucky ballot and showed him with 37% support, numerically ahead of both Donald Trump (31%) and Joe Biden (30%) ([source](https://insidesources.com/ky-gov-matt-bevin-proud-son-of-the-north-country-speaks-cold-hard-truth//created)). While the poll's methodology is not detailed in the available evidence, the claim's factual assertion about the poll results is supported.

adopted_qa_evidence.answer: Yes, Kanye West was officially listed as a presidential candidate on the ballot in Kentucky for the November 2020 general election.
